Cafe.title: Cafe
Cafe.description: Represents a cafe entity within the CampusCafe application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Cafe entity.

isOpen.description: Indicates whether the cafe is currently open.

openingTime.description: The time when the cafe opens, format HH:MM.

closingTime.description: The time when the cafe closes, format HH:MM.

avgPrepTimeMins.description: Average preparation time for orders in minutes.

approved.description: Indicates whether the cafe has been approved by an admin.

isDisabled.description: Indicates whether the cafe is currently disabled.

createdAt.description: Timestamp representing when the cafe was created.

MenuItem.title: MenuItem
MenuItem.description: Represents a menu item offered by a cafe.

id.description: Unique identifier for the MenuItem entity.

isVeg.description: Indicates whether the menu item is vegetarian.

isAvailable.description: Indicates whether the menu item is currently available.

isPopular.description: Indicates whether the menu item is popular.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp representing when the menu item was last updated.

Order.title: Order
Order.description: Represents an order placed by a customer.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Order entity.

customerName.description: Name of the customer who placed the order.

cafeName.description: Name of the cafe where the order was placed.

items.description: List of item names in the order.

specialInstructions.description: Any special instructions provided by the customer.

deliveryMode.description: The delivery mode for the order ('pickup' or 'delivery').

status.description: The current status of the order.

etaMins.description: Estimated time of arrival in minutes.

totalAmount.description: The total amount of the order.

createdAt.description: Timestamp representing when the order was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp representing when the order was last updated.

Announcement.title: Announcement
Announcement.description: Represents an announcement displayed in the application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Announcement entity.

active.description: Indicates whether the announcement is currently active.

createdAt.description: Timestamp representing when the announcement was created.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to support the CampusCafe application with a focus on role-based access and efficient data retrieval.  Authorization Independence is achieved by storing all necessary authorization data directly within the documents, avoiding costly `get()` calls in security rules. For example, cafe details are included in the orders collection to avoid needing to query the cafe collection to fulfill an order.

Segregation is used to isolate announcements into their own collection to avoid mixing data with varying security requirements.

The structure supports QAPs by leveraging segregation (e.g. for announcements) and membership maps, if any, to enable secure list operations. For example, listing announcements is secure as it's isolated in its own collection. Role-based access is managed at the application level based on the user's role stored in local storage, which is enforced on the client-side, and database access is structured to align with these roles.
